profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Strong experience in .NET Technologies since beta Release of .NET (Dec’99)
Experience in developing web applications, based to satisfy the Customer Requirements
Confident self-starter, independent worker, team player
Honored by Microsoft as Microsoft Most Valuable Professional in .NET for the outstanding .NET skills and technical forum support for consistently 7 years(2000-2007).
Experience in mentoring and training team members on the current and conventional technologies.
